faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: Can’t find your answer? Call or WhatsApp Hema.

order.q: How do I place an order?
order.a: Add treats to your cart, fill in your delivery details, pick a date and tap “Send order on WhatsApp”. WhatsApp opens with your full order ready. Press send, and Hema replies to confirm.

noTyping.a: Yes. Call {phone}, send a voice message on WhatsApp, or tap “Request a call back” and leave just your number. Hema will take your order on the phone.

early.a: Dream Kitchen is pre-booking only, with no urgent orders. Every order is dispatched after {days} business days (Monday to Saturday), so it is made fresh for you. Checkout shows the earliest date you can pick.

arrive.a: You choose a preferred date at checkout. Hema confirms the exact delivery date on WhatsApp.

delivery.q: Where do you deliver, and what does it cost?
delivery.a: Anywhere in Karnataka (pincodes starting with 56, 57, 58 or 59), for a flat delivery charge of ₹{charge}.
delivery.aNoCharge: Anywhere in Karnataka (pincodes starting with 56, 57, 58 or 59). Hema confirms the delivery charge on WhatsApp when she confirms your order.

pay.a: There is no payment on the website. After Hema confirms your order on WhatsApp, she shares UPI details.

name.q: Can I have a name written on the box?
name.a: Yes, for ₹{namePrice}, on Brownie Tubs, Delight Boxes, the Assorted Cookie Dip Box and the Cookie Pie Tin. Turn on “Add a name on the box” when you choose the item, and type up to {nameMax} letters.

classes.q: How do the chocolate classes work?
classes.a: Pick a class and a date on the Classes page, then send your booking on WhatsApp. Hema confirms your seat. For in-person classes the address is shared after booking; online classes get a joining link.

change.a: Call or WhatsApp Hema as soon as you can, and she will tell you what is possible.
